stem_book: A uniform disc of radius r₀ lies on a smooth horizontal plane. A similar disc spinning with the angular velocity ω₀ is carefully lowered coaxially onto the first disc. How soon do both discs spin with the same angular velocity if the friction coefficient between them is equal to μ? (a) t = 3r₀ω₀/(8μg) (b) t = 5r₀ω₀/(8μg) (c) t = 5r₀ω₀/(3μg) (d) t = 7r₀ω₀/(3μg)
work: τ_friction = (2/3)μmg r0, I = mr0²/2 → α = 4μg/(3r0); common ω = ω0/2 → t = (ω0/2)/α = 3r0ω0/(8μg)
